ni_n_and_root_s: 8.4.17 changes the n of ni; 8.3.65 separately changes the initial s of syati after the qualifying preverb. 8.3.63 retains the latter change across the augment.
perfect_limit: Mādhava explicitly gives abhisasau with dental s in both syllables; 8.3.64 limits the transfer of retroflexion across a reduplicative syllable. The ordered perfect here uses this cited base and the separately qualified ni.
han: The Mādhavīya explicitly contrasts hanti, hataḥ and ghnanti, and cites jaghāna/jaghnatuḥ. Compare direct pra + han with 8.4.22 and the optional v/m environment of 8.4.23.
attestation: The source directly quotes the ordered present of both and the imperfect praṇyaṣyad before a boundary in its lettering. Other selected words are qualified written combinations.
